summary: The stakeholder emphasizes the importance of the E-Rate program for their personal educational experience and opposes any proposals that would limit or sunset the program, arguing that screen-time expectations should remain a local issue.

claims.requested_action: Maintain current screen-time expectations for local control
claims.argument: Screen-time expectations should remain a local issue
claims.evidence_quote: It is because of the E-Rate program that the schools I attended, and the few public libraries I visited during my youth, were able to provide me with the ability to access the internet and gave me the potential to learn as much as I could. Therefore, I believe screen-time expectations should remain strictly a local issue. I urge the FCC to reject any proposal that would narrow, sunset, or eliminate the E-Rate program in any capacity.
